_说明: viewer3d.html?model=cathedral 的清单（标准档 cathedral.glb + 低档 cathedral_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米；Blender (x, y, z) → (x, z, -y)）。由 blender/landmarks/cathedral/build.py + blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成；周边中层街区（bg_*）只在成图里，不导出。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 哥特式西立面：两座方塔的外角各有三段收分的角扶壁（每段带披水与滴水线），上接八角钟楼层和实心石尖塔（棱上卷叶饰、塔脚四个山墙老虎窗，塔尖约 118 m）。双塔之间是主门、方框里的玫瑰窗和尖山墙；三个门洞层层内收（中门六重、侧门五重拱券），门上有尖山花。
desc.en: Gothic west front: each tower has setback angle buttresses stepping back three times (with weatherings and drip courses), rising to an octagonal belfry and a solid stone spire with crockets and four gabled lucarnes (tip about 118 m). Between the towers: the main portal, a rose window in a square frame and a pointed gable; the three portals are deeply splayed (six orders at the centre, five at the sides) under gables.

desc.zh: 中殿、唱诗堂和后殿外侧的独立扶壁墩（离侧廊墙约 2 m，顶上有小尖塔压重），各用一道约 45° 的四分之一拱飞扶壁把高墙拱顶的侧推力越过侧廊屋顶传到墩上，落点在高墙檐口下方。
desc.en: Free-standing piers (about 2 m clear of the aisle walls, weighted by pinnacles) along the nave, choir and apse; each carries one quadrant-arch flying buttress at about 45°, landing just below the clerestory cornice, taking the vault thrust over the aisle roofs.

desc.zh: 交叉处先是一座带角扶壁和成对尖窗的方塔（约 44 m），再上一层带角尖塔的八角层，最上是鼓座：外围 28 根柱的柱廊、圆拱窗，上承氧化铜绿穹顶、细镀金肋和镀金采光亭。
desc.en: Over the crossing: a square tower with angle buttresses and paired lancets (about 44 m), an octagonal stage with corner pinnacles, then the drum ringed by 28 columns, carrying an oxidised-copper dome with slim gilded ribs and a gilded lantern.

desc.zh: 南北耳堂端墙各有一扇玫瑰窗（放射窗棂 + 圆形窗花）、一个内收尖拱门和角部扶壁尖塔。
desc.en: Each transept end has a rose window (radiating tracery with foiled circles), a receding pointed portal and pinnacled corner buttresses.

desc.zh: 东端半圆后殿，外绕一圈较低的回廊，三个多边形小礼拜堂向外放射，各有锥形屋顶和尖拱窗。
desc.en: The semicircular east apse is wrapped by a lower ambulatory with three polygonal chapels radiating from it, each with a conical roof and lancet windows.

desc.zh: 教堂南侧的方形回廊：四面走廊是扇形拱顶（等曲率肋从束柱展开），朝庭院一侧是带窗花的尖拱廊。庭院中央有八角井台，墙上有壁灯；大主教常在深夜沿回廊散步。
desc.en: A square cloister south of the church: the four walks have fan vaults (ribs of equal curvature spreading from wall shafts) and open onto the garth through traceried pointed arcades. An octagonal well-head stands in the centre and lanterns hang on the walls; the archbishop often walks here late at night.

desc.zh: 回廊南侧的三层石砌府邸：石竖棂窗、滴水罩、板岩坡顶和成排烟囱，经南回廊与教堂相连。
desc.en: A three-storey stone residence on the south side of the cloister, with stone-mullioned windows, hood moulds, a slate roof and chimney stacks, linked to the church through the south walk.
